disposition: separate mood and fatigue measures after mango leaf extract
assessment: The acute 300 mg leaf-extract crossover in healthy adults gives an inconclusive POMS Fatigue–Inertia treatment result (p=.354) and Depression–Dejection result (p=.398) in Supplementary File 4. Their time interactions are also inconclusive. Raw and dried fruit were unmeasured.

disposition: controlled pre-test caffeine and optional decaffeinated snack
assessment: Participants avoided caffeine for 12 hours and could choose decaffeinated tea or coffee after the 30-minute assessment. The option was repeated at the second visit. Assigned treatment was mango leaf extract or placebo, with no brewed coffee to fatigue estimate.

disposition: mango leaf extract and short daytime testing
assessment: The crossover tests two capsule doses of soluble extract and placebo, with assessments through five hours. Insomnia appears in the caffeine background. No raw fruit, sleep intervention or insomnia outcome was recorded.

disposition: soluble leaf extract with a separately reported fatigue outcome
assessment: Figure 5 reports no clear POMS fatigue change from baseline or between groups. The assigned food-derived ingredient was soluble leaf extract rather than raw mango flesh, and participants were healthy students.

disposition: soluble leaf extract and transient depressed mood
assessment: The group term was inconclusive (p=.401) and the group-by-time interaction had p<.001. Results report inconclusive post hoc between-group contrasts at all four time points. No dried fruit or Parkinson depression outcome was measured.

disposition: caffeine abstinence and common potato-chip lunch
assessment: Caffeine was restricted from the previous night. Potato chips were included in the standardized lunch. The two leaf extract doses and placebo were the assigned exposures. No brewed coffee fatigue or roasted potato insomnia contrast was measured.

disposition: exploratory POMS fatigue and soluble mango leaf extract
assessment: Fatigue was lower after extract versus placebo at 30 minutes, three hours and five hours. The exploratory subscale was uncorrected for multiplicity. The participants were healthy students given leaf extract, with no raw fruit or Parkinson result.

disposition: exploratory POMS depression and soluble mango leaf extract
assessment: Adjusted depressed mood was lower after 100 mg leaf extract than placebo at three hours (−1.39, p=.011) and five hours (−1.44, p=.009). Comparisons were exploratory and uncorrected. The trial excluded diagnosed major depression and had no dried fruit or Parkinson cohort.

disposition: coffee quantity as eligibility example and caffeine restriction
assessment: The eligibility description uses filtered coffee to express a high caffeine cutoff. Participants restricted caffeine the night before both sessions. Randomized treatment was leaf extract or placebo, with no brewed coffee fatigue comparison.

disposition: boiled or mashed potatoes and self-reported sleep duration
assessment: The adjusted prospective estimate was +0.9 minutes/day per 80 g/day (99% CI −0.6 to +2, p=.1, n=12,692). Table 2 identifies boiled or mashed potato without a roasted item. The study did not score insomnia severity or estimate a Parkinson-specific association.

disposition: non-soluble mango leaf extract with an inconclusive mental fatigue comparison
assessment: The 70-person 300 mg leaf-extract crossover found no clear change in task-related mental fatigue. No raw mango or Parkinson severity measure was tested.

disposition: caffeine restriction and optional decaffeinated coffee
assessment: The healthy adults avoided caffeine overnight and were offered decaffeinated tea or coffee after testing and a stressor. Brewed coffee was not assigned and the fatigue analysis contrasts mango leaf extract with placebo.

disposition: other polyphenols cited and leaf extract assigned
assessment: Cocoa-flavanol and fruit-flavanol studies are cited as cognitive context. The original study compared mango leaf extract with placebo and did not administer plain dark chocolate or raw grapes. Its mood scores do not estimate either claim.
